name: The Lantern Central Hotel
description:
Sign in to unlock the members-only price for your selected dates at The Lantern Central Hotel


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: The Lantern Central Hotel in Baku offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and city views. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and free WiFi.

Dining Experience: Guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast with halal options and a family-friendly restaurant serving Turkish cuisine in a traditional and modern ambience.

Convenient Facilities: The hotel provides a shared kitchen, minimarket, coffee shop, and child-friendly buffet. Additional services include a 24-hour front desk, concierge, and tour desk.

Prime Location: Located 24 km from Heydar Aliyev International Airport, the hotel is near attractions such as Fountains Square (2-minute walk), Maiden Tower (700 metres), and the Azerbaijan Carpet Museum (1.7 km). An ice-skating rink is also nearby.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.7 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

policies.content: Child policies Children of any age are welcome. Children 10 years and above will be charged as adults at this property. Cot and extra bed policies The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.
